Title: Yrel Balance Patch #1
Subtitle: Balance Update
Affected: Zul'jin Ranked Battleground rotations: + Volskaya Foundry
CleanedNotes:
=== Heroes: Alexstrasza ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Casting Dragonqueen no longer reveals Alexstrasza's location to enemies through the Fog of War until she is killed.
  • An enemy Alexstrasza's Dragonqueen model will no longer persist after she enters a vehicle in the Fog of War.

=== Heroes: Ana ===
[Updates]
  Abilities:
  • Shrike (Trait)
    • Now also applies Doses to Structures.

[Updates]
  Talents:
  • Level 20
    • Nullification Shield (Active)
      • Removed
    • New Talent: Hardened Shield (Active)
      • Activate to gain 75 Armor for 4 seconds, taking 75% less damage.
